text: Standing here between the closed, quiet order of a glass-walled conference room and the vibrant, creative energy of an exhibit on research and development, I am caught between two worlds: one of structured collaboration, the other of innovative inquiry. The stillness of the vacant room contrasts with the bold graphics and ideas just steps away. I feel a sense of possibility, like standing on the threshold between contemplation and action—a reminder that knowledge grows when order and creativity meet.
